capabilities: Sort by ranking, price, discount, or reviews
Show product cards in a widget

positive.expected_behavior: Calls search with a vacation-dress or one-piece query, returns product results, and shows the product widget with names and prices unchanged.
Calls search with a popular Nike sneakers query, returns matching products, and shows them in the product widget.
Calls search with a long-padding query and sort=discount, then presents discounted products in the widget.
Calls search with query about party supplies and sort=lprice, then shows matching products ordered by lowest price.

positive.description: Empty or sparse results handled gracefully
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search and reports that few or no matching products were found, without inventing product names or prices.

review.commerce_description: This plugin helps users discover LotteON products and open product pages on lotteon.com. It does not process payments, place orders, or complete checkout inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Replacement of the existing 롯데ON app (app-697c7692c2a4819195fe66d9be9666c4). Same product search functionality; MCP host/infrastructure migrated. Widget UI design updated; behavior and scope are unchanged. The previous listing will be unpublished after this version goes live.
